triggered_constraints.description: orders.order_ts 以 UTC 儲存，營運報表必須以台北時間（UTC+8）劃分日、月、季、年。換算後每月都有部分訂單改歸屬到下一個月（含跨年），不換算會造成月、季、年度歸屬錯誤。資料範圍含台北時間落在 2024 年與 2026 年的訂單，查詢 2025 年必須排除這兩端。資料本身無時區標記，時區規則來自文件。

input.query: SELECT s.shipment_id, s.carrier, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, o.order_ts, typeof(s.delivered_ts) AS t FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_total, COUNT(s.delivered_ts) AS n_delivered, ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') >= '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'

queries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS n_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN s.shipped_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_null_shipped, SUM(CASE WHEN s.delivered_ts < s.shipped_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_negative, MIN(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)) AS min_days, MAX(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)) AS max_days FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') >= '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'

final_answer.basis: 依語意層的時區規則，將 orders.order_ts 加 8 小時換算為台北時間後，取 2025-04-01 至 2025-07-01 之間的訂單，並連結 shipments。配送天數定義為 delivered_ts 減 shipped_ts（以天為單位），僅計入已送達的 9921 筆（總筆數 11112）。驗證結果：無負值、無空出貨時間，且每筆 shipment 對應不同訂單。
